sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face a home fixture against Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last six games and will be heavy favourites against bottom-half opponents Alsager, who have won just once all season and are second from bottom.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the two-point gap at the top after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, who sit third but have won just one of their last two, host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in good recent form with three wins in their last five, welcome Wednesfield Community, then face Brereton Social at home in midweek. Bilston Town, fifth-placed and unbeaten in their last three, travel to Foley Meir. Shawbury United, rock bottom on form with six consecutive defeats, face Barnton away, while New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a battle between mid-table sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads, struggling near the bottom, visit Telford Town in another lower-league encounter. Crewe play host to Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social begin their week at home to Widnes Town, who remain rooted to the bottom with just two points all season.
